text_block_list.text:
While on the way to get something I left
at the
training track...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Passerby
text_block_list.text:
There's an All Rep Showdown happening
in the
gym! We have to hurry and
support Baku!

My interest sparked, I peek into the
gymnasium...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class representative, I'll definitely be

victorious!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Baku! Show them your top
speed!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's my line! As head and
representative of the
disciplinary
committee, I'm gonna turn you to
dust!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text: So coooool! I got chills!

...I was going to just get the thing I'd
forgotten,
but instead I stumbled across
some absurd
showdown!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Have you come to cheer me
on?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What are the chances! To think you'd
just happen
upon the locale of a battle
that will go down in
history!
choice_data_list: いや、忘れ物取りに行く途中……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The All Rep Showdown is what separates
the
good from the great when it comes
to student
function representatives!
Until now, every battle
has ended in a
draw!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Today's winner will be crowned the
strongest
representative! But...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We need to decide our battleground.
This is our
fiftieth battle, and we're
running out of showdown
themes...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Actually... Trainer, Just a
moment
ago, you said you were on your
way to pick up
something you'd left
behind, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How about the person who picks up my
trainer's
forgotten item and returns back
here with it first
is the winner?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No objections here! Lending a hand is
part of our
duties! Which makes this the
ideal stage for a
battle between model
students!

And so, the curtain draws on the All Rep

Showdown...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is me who'd be victorious!
The
championship's title of "retrieving
Trainer's lost
property fastest" is all
mine!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! I lost! I barely even saw her for a
few
seconds before she was gone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That being said! Trainer, I think there's
something
else you forgot as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Do not fear, I will spell it out for you
then!
Lately, you've been focusing on
putting together
my training schedule
and neglecting to eat!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're the second-most extraordinary
person
after me, so it's not like you to
forget something
to start with! But it
seems the real thing you
forgot is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To give yourself a break from all the
work you do!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right, that's decided then! First off,
we need to
Bakushin some food into that
stomach of yours!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So, this is the power of the class rep... I
will
concede.  I cannot keep up, neither
in speed nor
in consideration.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
An absolute rep among reps! I got chills
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the showdown, the huge
helping of
yakisoba we devour reminds
me of just how big
the class rep's heart
is... My heart and stomach
are just filled
to the brim!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I did it! With this, I have taken the title
of
strongest representative!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ack! So that was the power of Bakushin! Such terrifying speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Indeed! But my trainer is the one
who helped
me get there!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Running to help out my trainer made me

remember my usual training routine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You've helped me out so much! It feels
satisfying
to return the favor by
returning your forgotten
item!
choice_data_list: 学びが活かせたんだな！
学びが活かせたんだね！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Agh! I was totally defeated! But I'm also
touched
by the bond you two share!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
What an emotional rollercoaster!
Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The victor, Sakura Bakushin O, continues
to be
showered with celebratory cheers!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... To think... my Bakushin would
be
outdone...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is the power of the head of the
disciplinary
committee! The seat of
strongest representative is
now mine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It can't be... It can't!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But it's fine! My loss will help me achieve
a new
and more powerful Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely win next time! I'll let you
warm the
seat for me until then!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... That's precisely what makes you
such an
incredible class representative!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Class Rep! That was a spectacular battle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O's intense passion
earns her a
round of applause from
everyone in the
gymnasium.
